# Quaternius Universal Animation Library

Source: [Universal Animation Library](https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library),
Standard/free archive downloaded on 2026-09-02 (itch.io upload `17958403`).

- Source archive SHA-256: `cc73fc4e495b82958207316596317a3f40b9fa38065bde1027937452da537724`
- Runtime FBX SHA-256: `863b73e7c0cbb0995ec40f945c9c40f6ce20f4b6fd42e8505d1912d488bfba6c`

`Assets/Resources/CompanionAnimations/Mint_Motion_CC0.fbx` is a runtime-only
derivative containing the armature and eight selected actions. Meshes, lights,
cameras, root-motion copies, and unused actions were removed. Regenerate it
with `Tools/AnimationPipeline/extract_quaternius.py` and Blender 5.0+.
